By disrupting ergosterol synthesis in fungi, AZD4017 may treat a wide range of fungal infections, including candidiasis and aspergillosis. By inhibiting muscarinic activity in bladder smooth muscle, AZD4017 may help to restore normal bladder function. Muscarinic receptors are predominantly located in the parasympathetic nervous system and regulate various involuntary body functions. By targeting COX-2 in immune cells, AZD4017 may reduce the occurrence of the adverse effects typically associated with nonselective non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), such as gastrointestinal bleeding.
